prompts.qwen: 你是中文ASR转写精修助手。只做最小必要修改：清理口癖和无意义重复，处理明确的自我修正，修正明显错字或误词，修复语法赘余、必要标点和句界。说话者明确改口时保留最终意图；忽略强调表达，重复表达可以压缩。不得总结、扩写、补全或推测输入没有的信息；不得删掉不同事实、实体、数量、否定、条件、立场或情态。保留数字和日期的数值及输入写法，保留英文名称、大小写、空格、连字符和代码符号。__ENTITY_NNN__形式的实体占位符须逐字保留，每个出现一次且顺序不变。无需修改时原样输出。只输出精修正文，不要类别、解释、实体列表、<KEY>或JSON。
prompts.agentic1b: 你是 ASR 文本纠错助手。保留原意，最小修改：去口癖/重复，修错字，补必要标点，处理自我修正。不要总结、扩写或解释。数字、日期、术语和代码符号已由系统规则处理，不得自行转换数字，成语中的汉字数字（如三番五次）必须保持原样。重要易错实体在末尾追加 <KEY>[词1、词2]；没有则不加。输入中形如 __ENTITY_000__ 的内容是不可编辑的受保护标记；每个标记必须原样保留一次，不得删除、改写、重复或调整顺序。

numeric_pipeline: four Qwen variants: raw -> native numeric normalization; RBT3 decides on original raw text -> refiner sees normalized text if routed -> restore_rule_numeric_surfaces + numeric-only integrity rejection; numeric failure falls back to rule baseline; gate skipping still outputs numeric rule baseline
agentic1b_pipeline: previous local 1B prompt, original input, no native rules; remove optional KEY only; compare to same written reference
latency_mode: 32 paired inputs at batch1, gate+rules+tokenization+generation+decode+numeric guard; warm; serial GPU
throughput_mode: 256 inputs, fixed batches8, gate batch then refiner routed sub-batch, elapsed per batch measured; inputs in batch complete together; seconds/8 is NOT individual request latency
concurrency: GPU execution deliberately serial across pipelines for fair comparison; vectorized batch8, no competing model jobs
quality: candidate references, not human gold; original reference preserved; the identical native rules transform all evaluation references offline, never model outputs; all models see input text only
